summary.text: Richard Graf is the Libertarian candidate for Colorado State Senate District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An author, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running because he believes government should be accountable, limited and close to the people.

paragraphs.text: Richard Graf earned a high school diploma from Lamar High School and an associate degree from Pikes Peak Community College in 2013, and his career experience includes working as an author.

In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Graf described himself as a husband, father, author and student of history who studied political science and history at Western State College of Colorado, and said he wrote a book titled The Sentinel Republic.
Graf listed accountable, limited government, taxpayer concerns and cost of living, and civic education and constitutional rights as his key campaign messages.

He said the policy areas he is most passionate about include constitutional accountability, education, fiscal responsibility, election integrity, healthcare transparency, public safety, water, agriculture and protecting rural Colorado.
